measurements.note: Wf-129 P2 replay learner regularised bench ran on the Wf-36 P4 synthetic replay buffer (n_entries=128, n_states=8, n_actions=16), NOT on the diversity-evolution pool. Replay learner final_policy_loss = 3.1316 ± 0.27 (target < 0.5, NOT MET); final_value_loss = 0.2969 (target < 1.0, MET). The W₂ regulariser is wired into the policy + value heads (mean_w2_policy = 0.1057, mean_w2_value = 0.4894) but does not lift the synthetic-fixture signal-noise. No diversity_tanimoto effect measurable on the Wf-36 P4 synthetic — the replay learner is upstream of the diversity evolution, not a Tanimoto driver. See TODO/completed/129_l2_l4_l7_joint_rescue.md §2.

the_4_fixes: Partner tiles (8 new: 3 azides + 3 boronic + 2 bromides)

verdict: VERIFIED_LIFT — diversity_tanimoto 0.000 -> 0.1065 on 30 cells after all 4 fixes ship + decoder_rework. Deterministic per-cell (std=0.0). Path B alone did NOT lift (need all 4). Gap to TargetDiff 0.860 still large but lift is real and reproducible. Wf-129 P2 replay learner (regularised, 5-seed × 30-epoch) ran on the Wf-36 P4 synthetic replay buffer (n_entries=128) — NO diversity_tanimoto effect measurable on the synthetic (final_policy_loss = 3.13, NOT lifted); the replay learner is upstream of the diversity evolution, not a Tanimoto driver. Real GPU retrain (TODO-92 P1.3) is the deferred workstream.
